title: SchoolEnrollmentStatus
description: Enrollment intensity status for a student's school attendance.

FULL_TIME.description: Student is enrolled on a full-time basis.

PART_TIME.description: Student is enrolled on a part-time basis.

LESS_THAN_PART_TIME.description: Student is enrolled at less than part-time intensity.

ENROLLED.description: Student is enrolled, but the enrollment intensity is unknown.
